title: "Ottawa Macdonald-Cartier International Airport, ON (NOAA)" weather station not updating
line: The Weather Report widget no longer offers Canadian and Mexican NOAA stations that could never load a forecast.
explanation: The NOAA ion needs api.weather.gov/points for every forecast, and that endpoint answers 404 'Data Unavailable For Requested Point' outside the US and its territories, so the ion gives up and the widget shows 'Unable to load weather forecast'. noaa_station_list.xml still carried 373 stations from NOAA's old station index that are in Canada (ICAO prefix C) or Mexico (prefix MM, including Tijuana filed under CA), and all of them fail this way; one station per non-US region was checked against the live API, while Puerto Rico, Guam, Virgin Islands, Northern Marianas and American Samoa work. The change deletes those 373 station entries from the list (pure deletion, 4103 lines), so they are no longer offered in the location search.

commits.message:
applets/weather: remove Canadian and Mexican stations from NOAA list

NOAA's forecast API only covers the US, so picking one of the Canadian
or Mexican stations in its list always ended in "Unable to load weather
forecast". Remove those stations, other providers cover these places.

BUG: 513791
